message.content: I'm ending my turn and keeping my $1,375 in cash. I didn't unmortgage the greens, because they earn nothing until I own Pacific. p1 has only $69 left, and landing on one of their orange hotels could cost me around $1,000, so the cash is my safety margin. I also didn't raise my Pacific offer, since extra cash now would only help p1 last longer.
message.reasoning:
I'm weighing whether unmortgaging the greens is even worth it without owning Pacific, and tallying the unmortgage costs for Ventnor, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Water Works. Since p1 already turned down $250 for Pacific and is cash-strapped with hotels on oranges, I'm considering whether a higher offer could work, though completing the greens would still require houses from a limited bank supply.

Buying Pacific might just prolong p1's survival, so maybe it's smarter to hold onto cash in case p1's orange hotels hit me with heavy rent. With $1375 on hand, I think I'll just keep my buffer and end the turn rather than unmortgaging anything right now.

function.name: end_turn
function.arguments: {"public_message": "Thanks for the $750. Your roll, p1. My Pacific offer still stands."}
